sources.mapping: inputs/Logical Identifiers and CAN Mapping v1_76.xlsx
sources.mapping_proxi_sheet: Proxi & Configuration (Atlantis & Atlantis High block = cols 16-20)

dbc_survey.note: Both DBCs are required. They share only 24 messages, and $FuelLvlLow$ exists on CAN-B alone.

_meta.lookup_note: Mapping-table Logical Identifiers are stored UPPER CASE (VC_VEH_LINE, VC_VEH_BRAND). Workbook tokens use three casings of the same id. Lookups must be case-insensitive.

forbidden_value_labels.reason: R-P15 — 兩份 DBC 皆無此字串。CAN 送值標籤一律以 DBC VAL_ 表為準；Command_02Sts 合法標籤為 Not_Pressed / Pressed / SNA。
forbidden_value_labels.scope: 所有 CAN 送值步驟

_meta.enum_authority_rule: R-P20 — PROXI 之列舉值為權威；`Logical Identifiers and CAN Mapping` 僅供 Logical Identifier → 訊號／配置字名稱之對映，其列舉值不具權威性（v1_76 的 VC_VEH_LINE 截斷於 101 = WL，缺 102/103/104/105/106/124/130；PROXI Format row 466 完整列至 130 = HDCC）。L-PJ2 值域檢查一律對 PROXI 執行，不得對 mapping 執行。
_meta.d8_field_split: 原 workbook_rows 語意混用且未載明掃描範圍（A-PJ55）。依 D-8 拆為三欄，欄名載明範圍：token_rows_prerefine_scanrisk（歷史記錄，凍結，範圍 = lint_defs.SCAN_RISK 六個文字欄，可復現原值 22/15/19/4/2/3/2）、token_rows_postrefine_scanrisk（現況，須同步）、token_rows_postrefine_editable（僅可編輯三欄，供 gate 用）。

$Day_Night_Mode$.trap: The mapping table lists TWO spellings in one cell: BCM_FD_27.DAY_LGT_MODE_DISP and BCM_FD_27.DAY_LGT_MD_DISP. Only DAY_LGT_MD_DISP exists in either DBC — DAY_LGT_MODE_DISP resolves in neither. Take DAY_LGT_MD_DISP; writing the other aborts under L-PJ1.

$VC_Veh_Line$.ruling: R-P8′ (supersedes R-P8, 2026-08-12) — 保留解除。workbook 的 `$VC_VEH_Line$ = 332` 更正為 `Car_Configuration_15.Vehicle_Line_Configuration = 105 (332)`；332 是代碼 105 的標籤，不是配置值。DR#3 關閉。
$VC_Veh_Line$.casing: Three casings appear in the workbook and all denote the same LID. Unifying them is a wording fix under O-1, not a semantic change.
$VC_Veh_Line$.superseded_ruling: R-P8 — 原文保留不動，Remarks 註記待確認（2026-08-12 由 R-P8′ 取代）

equivalent_source.note: R-P10 — record in Remarks as the equivalent source. The mapping table lists both in one cell; the two DBCs carry identical value tables for this signal.

$HUModeStatus$.caution: The DBC labels carry the _Selected suffix (AM_Selected, not AM). L-PJ1 compares against the DBC VAL_ table, so the suffix must be written as the DBC has it.
$HUModeStatus$.open: Leaf SWE1-PROJ-184 requires $HUModeStatus$ = [TGW_USB1_Sel]. That label was NOT confirmed present in the CurrentSource value table during Phase 0 — it must be looked up before any step is written. 184 is one of the 7 uncovered leaves.

$FuelLvlLow$.note: CAN-B only — absent from FDCAN8. This token alone makes the BHCAN file non-optional.

$Screen_Size$.resolution: dual-source — mapping LID `Head_Unit_Screen_Size` + PROXI `Radio_Display_Type`（R-P7 升格；A-PJ13）
$Screen_Size$.ruling: R-P7 — the 6 rows whose Remarks read `only 8.4"` are written as Radio_Display_Type = 2. Those rows are 425, 426, 428, 429, 430, 431.

$HCP_DISP2.Est_Range_BEV$.ruling: R-P9 — open RD-1; write the step in observable form per O-4; DO NOT fill a signal.

near_candidates.note: this is what the mapping table's Atlantis High column gives for LID Est_Range_Disp; the 下放包 named IPC_FD_5.Est_Range_Disp, which is a different arch's column. IPC_FD_5.Est_Range_Disp does exist in FDCAN8.

$HCP_DISP2.Est_Range_BEV$.prohibition: The three candidates are not equivalent to one another. Choosing any one of them is fabrication and is forbidden. The mapping table carries 9 Est_Range* LIDs and none of them is a BEV variant.

proxi_preconditions._note: PROXI configuration words available for writing vague pre-conditions concretely (O-2 puts these in Pre-Conditions, never in Input Test Data).

Projection_Mode.note: To disable projection entirely, this parameter — not Projection_Mode_Selection — must be Absent.

Projection_Mode_Selection.encoding: bitfield; each bit set to 1 activates one projection mode, and modes combine by summing
Projection_Mode_Selection.exception: Value 0 does NOT mean the modes are disabled. It activates both CarPlay and Android Auto, for backward compatibility with earlier projects.

can_step_pattern._source: Shape taken from the SWC workbook (cross-feature, style only — A-PJ07).
elements: message.signal = value (enumeration label) in a Procedure step

procedure: 1. Read the current HU volume and record it as Vol_initial
5. Read the HU volume and check that it is lower than Vol_initial

can_step_pattern.correction: The 下放包 §5 wrote the enumeration labels as (PSD) and (NOT_PSD). The FDCAN8 VAL_ table for BCM_FD_14.Command_02Sts is 0 "Not_Pressed" / 1 "Pressed" / 3 "SNA". PSD and NOT_PSD appear in neither DBC, so the pattern as written would ABORT under L-PJ1. The labels above are the DBC's own. See A-PJ12.
can_step_pattern.cross_feature_rule: R-P15 — 取 SWC 範式的**結構**（PROXI 前置 → message.signal = 值 (標籤) → 明確持續時間 → 讀值比對），**不取其字面標籤**。
